name: PKCS#7 Packer
description: Bundle several certificates into one PKCS#7 certificate bag (.p7b) for distribution.

examples.label: Pack the leaf and the CA into a P7B

hints.certsOnly: Only **certificate bags** are supported: signed or encrypted PKCS#7 containers are out of scope for this version.
hints.bundle: Concatenate PEM blocks and the tool picks them up one by one.

faq.q: What is the difference between P7B and PFX?
faq.a: A P7B holds certificates only (public material); a PFX also holds the private key and needs a passphrase.

faq.q: Can it produce a code-signing container?
faq.a: No. This version only builds certificate bags; signed containers need upstream support.
The bag itself is unordered; use the chain parser when you need an ordered chain.
